div.p: I understand the treatment my practitioner has explained to me, what it involves, and that, like any treatment, it can carry risks such as discomfort or a reaction. I understand that results vary and that no specific outcome is guaranteed.
I have told my practitioner about my health, medications, allergies and anything else that could affect this treatment, and I will tell them if any of it changes.
I have received aftercare instructions and understand it is my responsibility to follow them. I may stop the treatment at any time.

I understand that a check will be done before treatment begins, such as applying a small amount of a product to my skin to look for a reaction, and that I may need to come back to have the result read within the time my practitioner gives me.
I will contact the practice straight away if I notice redness, swelling or any other reaction before then.

I give permission for before and after photos taken during my treatment to be used in the practice's portfolio and marketing. No identifying information beyond the images themselves will be shared without my separate, written permission.
I may withdraw this permission at any time, in writing or in my client portal.
